calculator.reason: More feature-complete (3 shapes vs 2) and matches the pool-X-calculator naming convention every sibling calculator follows.

charts.reason: Root page is actively generator-maintained; charts/ version is orphaned static content.
Higher inbound-link count; is the URL embedded in the sitewide footer partial.

root_causes: generate-sitemaps.js used a hand-maintained blocklist missing reports/, audit/, qa/, components/
No centralized production/indexation policy existed prior to this phase
inject-seo-metadata.js unconditionally overwrote every page's robots meta with index,follow on every build, silently reverting noindex flags
Duplicate calculator was registered as a first-class entry in 8+ generator/data files
Legacy chart pages were orphaned static files coexisting with actively-generated equivalents
url-engine.js's duplicate-segment collapse rule incorrectly collapsed the intentional /legal/legal URL

sitemap.policy: generate-sitemaps.js now calls urlPolicy.isSitemapEligible() per candidate file instead of a hand-maintained blocklist

canonicals.canonical_points_elsewhere_note: Same count, but now the correct intentional defense-in-depth pattern (retired pages canonicalize to their replacement), not a defect
canonicals.legal_legal_fix: js/url/url-engine.js duplicate-segment collapse rule fixed with an explicit, idempotent allowlist exception

validator.wired_into: scripts/run-all-generators.js, after generate-sitemaps.js and before certification steps

regression_tests.manual_demonstration: flipped retired calculator to index,follow -> validator failed with DUPLICATE_URL_STILL_INDEXABLE -> restored -> validator passed; also caught and fixed a dead-code bug in the validator itself

live_certification.method: local static server honoring _redirects (deployment not authorized this phase)

pre_existing_issues_discovered.description: generate-entity-pages.js is require()d twice in run-all-generators.js; Node module caching means only the first (premature) call's side effects apply
pre_existing_issues_discovered.impact: A data fix to entity calculatorIds takes one extra full build cycle to propagate into entities/*.html
pre_existing_issues_discovered.reason: Reordering safely requires auditing every step between the two require() calls; beyond this phase's mandate

pre_existing_issues_discovered.description: inject-footer.js (and possibly other injectors) have minor whitespace-only non-determinism across repeated builds
pre_existing_issues_discovered.impact: Cosmetic only -- confirmed via direct diff that no canonical/link/content changes accompany it

deferred_findings: Content provenance, programmatic duplication, external citations, trust/author signals, thin-content findings
7 orphaned root-level chart pages with no maintaining generator (not duplicated, just unowned)
